notes.title: Version 0.9.1 Update
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added gamepad support
[*] Added 1 new stage
[*] Added 2 new monsters
[*] Changed movement/attack mechanics
[*] Adjusted game balance
[*] Fixed bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 Release
notes.content:
Hello,
We have unexpectedly released version 0.9.0 of the game. While the game is still lacking in some areas, we will continue to enhance it through regular updates to make it more enjoyable.

[b]Upcoming Update (November 22)[/b]
Gamepad support
New stage
New summon


Please share your thoughts in the Steam discussion board.

Thank you.
